1. __run-headless leaf: --harness <H> override (validated pi|omp|opencode|grok), model resolved for the overridden harness.
2. headless_dispatch: read spec.harness from the dispatch_job spec, pass through to the leaf (defaults to profile harness).
3. Built-in review/debate workflows: reviewer dispatch steps get harness: opencode.
4. pane_dispatch: resolve the override — dispatch to a pane of that harness if one exists; clear error otherwise (crew pre-spawn stays profile-based).
5. Gate: review workflow reviewer step resolves harness=opencode (not omp); profile list still shows reviewer omp; 448+ tests green.
